selection_scope: Current preferred checkpoint for the tested fixed 18 cm hybrid stair scenario; selected for success and speed/stability balance, not best on every metric.
counter_scope: Stable-fast training chain; does not include prior warm-start source training updates.

source_consistency.archive_note: The published tar preserves each of the 84 remaining source files byte-for-byte; two server monitoring scripts with connection configuration were excluded. The original snapshot is retained locally.

evaluation.gait_quality_subset: Successful first episodes, stair flight horizontal projection only; approach and upper platform excluded.

selection_reason: 1100 retained 128/128 successes, increased measured stair speed and reduced roll RMS and mean outward hip component relative to 600. 1600 was faster but had 127/128 successes and higher roll RMS than 600.
limitations: 0.6 m/s is a command; selected checkpoint measured stair traversal speed is approximately 0.464 m/s.

1100 inside-minimum foot-position sampling fraction increased to 11.60% from 2.55%; mostly left rear foot (45.93%). This means per-foot signed body-frame lateral position below 0.12 m, not inter-foot separation or failed episodes; stair cross-body-center sampling fraction is zero.
Development evaluation on seeds 42/43, not held-out terrain, perturbation, real-robot validation, or a population success guarantee.
Long-approach and pure-flat 64/64 records and the original 114-test run belong to the earlier 600 model; not repeated for 1100.
completed.json and TensorBoard/training logs describe the entire continuation through 1600; only model_1100.pt is newly archived as the selected checkpoint.
Resume restores networks and optimizer states but recreates simulation, curriculum and random-number state.
